project.name: Demo Shop
project.description: A tiny shop used to test the eval tooling.

sprints.name: Sprint 1
sprints.goal: Customers can pay with a card

items.title: Online checkout
items.description: Everything a shopper needs to turn a full basket into a paid order.

items.title: Card payments
items.description: Accept credit and debit cards through the payment provider, including 3-D Secure challenges.
acceptanceCriteria: A valid card completes the order
A declined card shows the reason

items.title: Pay with a saved card
items.description: Returning shoppers pick a card they stored before and confirm with their security code.
acceptanceCriteria: Saved cards are listed by last four digits

comments.body: We agreed to store only the provider token, never the card number.

items.title: Basket total wrong after removing a coupon
items.description: The total still shows the discounted price after the shopper removes the voucher code.
items.reproSteps:
1. Add two items.
2. Apply a voucher.
3. Remove the voucher.
4. The total stays reduced.

items.title: Call the provider sandbox from CI
items.description: Add a nightly job that places a test payment against the sandbox.

items.title: Order confirmation emails
items.description: Send an email with the order summary within a minute of payment.
acceptanceCriteria: The email lists every line item

items.title: Resend a lost receipt
items.description: A shopper who cannot find the message can ask for it again from their order page.

comments.body: Rate limit this to three sends an hour to avoid abuse of the mail relay.

items.title: Delivery estimates
items.description: Show the expected arrival date for each shipping method before the shopper pays.

items.title: Postcode field rejects spaces
items.description: UK postcodes such as SW1A 1AA are refused at the delivery step.
items.reproSteps: Enter SW1A 1AA as the postcode and press Continue.

items.title: Gift wrap option
items.description: Offer paper and a card message for an extra fee.

comments.body: Dropped: the warehouse cannot do it this year.

items.title: Zahlung mit Rechnung
items.description: Kunden in Deutschland können auf Rechnung bezahlen und erhalten 14 Tage Zeit.

items.title: Add a spinner while the payment is processing
items.description: The pay button should be disabled and show progress until the provider answers.

items.title: Customer accounts
items.description: Shoppers keep their details, orders and saved cards in one place.

items.title: Sign-in and password reset
items.description: Email and password sign-in, with a reset link for people who forgot theirs.

items.title: Password reset link expires immediately
items.description: The emailed link says it has expired even when it is opened seconds after arriving.
items.reproSteps:
1. Request a reset.
2. Open the link straight away.
3. The page reports an expired token.

comments.body: The server clock and the token issuer disagree by about an hour, which looks like a time zone slip.

items.title: Remember me on this device
items.description: Keep the shopper signed in for thirty days when they tick the box.

items.title: Rotate session cookies on sign-in
items.description: Issue a fresh cookie when the shopper authenticates so an old one cannot be reused.

items.title: Order history
items.description: A list of past orders with status, totals and a link to each receipt.

items.title: Cancelar un pedido antes del envío
items.description: El cliente puede cancelar un pedido mientras todavía no haya salido del almacén.

items.title: Order list is empty for guests who check out
items.description: Guests see no orders after paying, even though the confirmation email arrived.
items.reproSteps: Check out as a guest, then open the order list.

comments.body: Only happens when the guest session cookie was issued before the cart merge ran.
